item.title: Catalyst IOS Reaches $400 Million Final Close For Third Fund
item.description: Catalyst Investment Partners, an owner and operator focused on industrial outdoor storage (IOS), has announced the final close of its third fund at a $400 million hard cap in limited partner commitments. The firm said Fund III exceeded an original $300 million target and was substantially oversubscribed, with investor demand approaching twice the target and well above the hard cap. The post Catalyst IOS Reaches $400 Million Final Close For Third Fund appeared first on Pulse 2.0.

item.title: TransPerfect Acquires German Post Production Studio Omnimago
item.description: TransPerfect, a provider of language and AI solutions for global business, has acquired Omnimago GmbH, a German film restoration and post-production studio. Omnimago will join TransPerfect Media, the company’s media and entertainment division. Financial terms were not disclosed. The post TransPerfect Acquires German Post Production Studio Omnimago appeared first on Pulse 2.0.

item.title: DLP Capital Crosses $2 Billion In Capital Under Management
item.description: DLP Real Estate Capital, a private real estate investment firm headquartered in St. Augustine, Florida, said it has surpassed $2 billion in capital under management (CapUM) across its sponsored real estate credit and equity funds. The firm said the CapUM total spans strategies including the DLP Housing Fund, DLP Lending Fund, DLP Preferred Credit Fund, DLP Building Communities Fund, and DLP LivingFully Community Fund. item.title: Coller Capital Leads $1.3 Billion Private Credit Continuation Vehicle With Ares
item.description: Coller Capital announced it has closed a continuation vehicle for Ares U.S. Direct Lending’s 2018-vintage fund with more than $1.3 billion in total commitments. The continuation vehicle includes a diversified portfolio of first-lien, floating-rate loans to U.S. middle-market companies backed by private equity sponsors. item.title: AstraZeneca Awards $3.4 Million To Fund 47 U.S. Nonprofit Programs Aimed At Improving Healthcare Access
item.description: AstraZeneca has awarded $3.4 million to nonprofit organizations across the United States through its Accelerate Change Together (ACT) on Health Equity initiative, funding programs that address social, cultural, and linguistic barriers that limit access to care and opportunity.
